---
title: Scanning and media
description: Codes, images and audio the engine can read or produce without a service.
---

These live on the engine rather than a session, because none of them need a
stream of frames. You hand them bytes and get an answer back, on the device.

## QR codes

```c
uint8_t payload[512];
size_t len = 0;
goss_engine_scan_qr(engine, luminance, width, height, payload, sizeof payload, &len);
```

Luminance is the plane you already have from the camera, so there's no need to
convert to RGB just to read a code.

Generating one:

```c
uint8_t image[256 * 256];
uint32_t dim = 0;
goss_engine_generate_qr(engine, payload, payload_len,
                        6,    /* module scale */
                        4,    /* quiet modules */
                        image, sizeof image, &dim);
```

The quiet zone isn't decoration. Four modules is the spec's minimum, and
dropping it gives you codes that scan fine on your desk and fail on a table.

## Barcodes

```c
uint8_t digits[32];
goss_engine_scan_barcode(engine, luminance, width, height, digits);
```

## Images

```c
goss_engine_decode_png(bytes, len, rgba, capacity, &width, &height, &written);
```

Decoding here keeps a lens's assets and your app's images on the same path,
with the same colour rules.

## Audio

```c
uint32_t track_id = 0, votes = 0;
goss_engine_music_identify(engine, samples, frame_count, sample_rate, channels,
                           min_votes, &track_id, &votes);
```

`min_votes` is the confidence floor, and the votes come back so you can make
your own call. An app that shows a guess at low confidence and a certainty at
high confidence is more useful than one that only speaks when it's sure.

References are added and cleared on the engine:

```c
goss_engine_music_add_reference(engine, ...);
goss_engine_music_clear_references(engine);
```

## Why these are on the engine

None of this needs the frame graph, and none of it leaves the device. If all
you're doing is scanning a code, you don't open a session, you don't start a
camera pipeline, and you don't pay for either.
